chapterInfo.content:
19
Yuda sɛeɛ ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi
1Sɛ AWURADE kaeɛ nie: Kɔ na kɔtɔ ɔnwomfoɔ kuruwa bi, na fa ɔman no mu mpanimfoɔ ne asɔfoɔ mu mpanimfoɔ no bi ka wo ho, 2#Yer 19.11; 7.31 na firi adi kɔ Hinom ba bonhwa a ɛwɔ anwomfoɔ pono ano no mu, na pae nsɛm a mɛka akyerɛ wo no wɔ hɔ. 3#1 Sa 3.11; 2 Ah 21.12 Na ka sɛ: Montie AWURADE asɛm, Yuda ahemfo ne Yerusalemfoɔ, sɛ asafo AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Hwɛ, mede adebɔne mereba ɛha yi a obiara a ɔbɛteɛ no, n’aso mu bɛyɛ no kyeoo. 4Ɛsiane sɛ wɔagya me, na wɔadi ananafoɔ asɛm wɔ ɛha yi, na wɔahye aduhwam wɔ ha ama anyame foforɔ a wɔne wɔn agyanom ne Yuda ahemfo nhunuu wɔn pɛn, na wɔde bemdifoɔ mogya ahyɛ ɛha yi ma. 5#Yer 7.31-32 Na wɔasisi Baal sorɔnsorɔmmea, de gya hye wɔn mma abobɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ma Baal, nso menhyɛɛ wɔn saa, na ɛmmaa m’adwene mu da. 6Saa nti, hwɛ, AWURADE asɛm nie, nna bi reba a wɔremfrɛ ha yi sɛ Tofet anaasɛ Hinom ba bonhwa bio, na mmom wɔbɛfrɛ no Okum Bonhwa. 7#Yer 7.33 Na mɛma Yuda ne Yerusalem agyina ayɛ hunu ɛha yi, na mama wɔatotɔ afena ano, wɔn atamfoɔ anim ne wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wɔn kra no nsam, na mede wɔn afunu mama ewiem nnomaa ne wiram mmoa adi. 8#Yer 18.16 Na mɛyɛ kuro yi amamfo ne fɛdie adeɛ, obiara a ɔbɛtwam wɔ ho no, ne sɛeɛ no nyinaa nti ne ho bɛdwiri no na wabɔ hwerɛma hweehwee. 9#Deut 28.53 Na mɛma wɔadi wɔn mmammarima nam ne wɔn mmammaa nam, na wɔbɛdi wɔn ho wɔn ho nam, ahohiahia ne ahodwan a wɔn atamfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn akum wɔn no de bɛdwan wɔn ho no mu.
10Na bɔ kuruwa no mmarima a wɔne wo bɛkorɔ no anim, 11#Yes 30.14; Yer 7.32 na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Sɛdeɛ wɔbɔ ɔnwomfoɔ kukuo a wɔntumi nyɛ no yie bio no, saa ara na mɛbɔ ɔman yi ne kuro yi. Na Tofet ara na wɔbɛsie wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ wɔrennya baabi nsie bio. 12Saa ara na mɛyɛ ɛha yi ne ɛhafoɔ, AWURADE asɛm nie, na mɛyɛ kuro yi sɛ Tofet. 13#Yer 32.29; Sef 1.5 Na Yerusalem afie ne Yuda ahemfo afie no ho bɛgu fi sɛ Tofet hɔ, adan a wɔahyehye atifi aduhwam ama ɔsoro asafo no nyinaa, na wɔahwie ahwiesa ama anyame foforɔ no nyinaa bɛyɛ sɛ Tofet.
14Ɛnna Yeremia firii Tofet, deɛ AWURADE somaa no adiyisɛm ka hɔ baeɛ, na ɔkɔgyinaa AWURADE fie abannwa mu, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ: 15Sɛ asafo AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Hwɛ, mede bɔne a maka agu kuro yi soɔ no nyinaa bɛba ɛno ne ɛho nkuro nyinaa so, ɛfiri sɛ wɔasene wɔn kɔn, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔantie me nsɛm.

Sɛ AWURADE kaeɛ nie: Kɔ na kɔtɔ ɔnwomfoɔ kuruwa bi, na fa ɔman no mu mpanimfoɔ ne asɔfoɔ mu mpanimfoɔ no bi ka wo ho, na firi adi kɔ Hinom ba bonhwa a ɛwɔ anwomfoɔ pono ano no mu, na pae nsɛm a mɛka akyerɛ wo no wɔ hɔ. Na ka sɛ: Montie AWURADE asɛm, Yuda ahemfo ne Yerusalemfoɔ, sɛ asafo AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Hwɛ, mede adebɔne mereba ɛha yi a obiara a ɔbɛteɛ no, n’aso mu bɛyɛ no kyeoo. Saa nti, hwɛ, AWURADE asɛm nie, nna bi reba a wɔremfrɛ ha yi sɛ Tofet anaasɛ Hinom ba bonhwa bio, na mmom wɔbɛfrɛ no Okum Bonhwa. Na bɔ kuruwa no mmarima a wɔne wo bɛkorɔ no anim, na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Sɛdeɛ wɔbɔ ɔnwomfoɔ kukuo a wɔntumi nyɛ no yie bio no, saa ara na mɛbɔ ɔman yi ne kuro yi. Ɛnna Yeremia firii Tofet, deɛ AWURADE somaa no adiyisɛm ka hɔ baeɛ, na ɔkɔgyinaa AWURADE fie abannwa mu, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Hwɛ, mede bɔne a maka agu kuro yi soɔ no nyinaa bɛba ɛno ne ɛho nkuro nyinaa so, ɛfiri sɛ wɔasene wɔn kɔn, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔantie me nsɛm.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
